admission.justification: Filtering decision rows alone does not stop future finalizer pollution, stopping appends alone would remove the old time source, and a completion-time field alone does not preserve authored-only reading; together the members separate human history from lifecycle evidence while retaining completion recency and old records.

guarantee: Finalization leaves authored task/master decision arrays intact and lifecycle proof in status, the exact master row and landing record; decision surfaces count and number authored entries and disclose retained product records separately. An independent completion fact for new landings and read-only legacy fallback let the ordinary master’s completion list and newest-five preview report recency after finalizer decision appends stop, without rewriting old documents or persisting sort choice. Existing exact/prefix product-record classification, including possible authored collisions, remains a disclosed boundary rather than an enforced authorship guarantee.
title: Authored decision history and durable completion recency
